READ-ONLY UX/design-consistency audit of the Nxeon CUSTOMER PORTAL (the logged-in dashboard) at /opt/nxeon, under `app/dashboard/` + `components/customer/`. Do NOT edit/build/mutate — catalog only.

The portal was built feature-by-feature over time, so older sections may be inconsistent with newer ones in layout, components, and flow. Audit every section: activity, billing, invoices, deploy, order, servers, games, hosting, sites, nxcloud, domains, ssl, volumes, email, mail, build, claude-code, projects, team, refer, affiliate, settings, support, feedback, migrate, calendar, plus the dashboard shell (`app/dashboard/layout.tsx`, sidebar/nav).

First read a few clearly-recent, well-built sections (e.g. servers/[id], deploy wizard, billing) to establish the current standard (shared UI primitives in components/ui/*, card styling, page headers, tables, empty states, buttons, spacing, toasts/errors). Then find where OTHER sections DIVERGE: one-off styling vs shared primitives, inconsistent page headers/empty-states/tables/buttons, different spacing/typography, dated layouts, broken or confusing flows, dead links, half-finished features, inconsistent terminology, missing loading/error states.

Deliverable: a prioritized punch-list grouped by section — for each: the inconsistency/flow issue, severity, and the concrete fix (which shared primitive/pattern to adopt). Call out the shared components that should be the standard, and list sections that are already consistent (leave alone). Be specific with file paths so I can execute in waves.
